import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
import os
import re

# Suppress warnings to keep stdout clean
import logging

logging.getLogger("sklearn").setLevel(logging.ERROR)


def calc_multiclass_log_loss(y_true_indices, y_pred_normalized, eps=1e-15):
    """Calculate multi-class log loss: -1/N * sum(y_ij * log(p_ij))"""
    N = len(y_true_indices)
    y_pred_normalized = np.clip(y_pred_normalized, eps, 1 - eps)
    total_loss = 0
    for i in range(N):
        true_class_idx = y_true_indices[i]
        pred_prob = y_pred_normalized[i, true_class_idx]
        total_loss -= pred_prob * np.log(pred_prob)
    return abs(total_loss / N)


def main():
    # Load data
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
    sample_sub.columns = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

    class_mapping = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
    reverse_map = {0: "EAP", 1: "HPL", 2: "MWS"}

    # Preprocessing function to normalize text
    def preprocess_text(text):
        text = str(text).lower()
        text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        return text

    # Apply preprocessing to both training and test sets
    X_train_text = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text).astype(str).values
    X_test_text = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text).astype(str).values
    y_train_full = train_df["author"].map(class_mapping).values

    # Split training data into train/validation (genuine holdout)
    n_train = X_train_text.shape[0]
    np.random.seed(42)
    n_val_size = int(n_train * 0.2)
    val_indices = np.random.choice(np.arange(n_train), size=n_val_size, replace=False)
    train_indices = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(n_train), val_indices)

    X_train_final = X_train_text[train_indices]
    y_train_final = y_train_full[train_indices]
    y_val = y_train_full[val_indices]

    # Create separate vectors for word and character n-grams
    word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
    char_bigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=20000, ngram_range=(2, 2), analyzer="char"
    )
    char_trigram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=20000, ngram_range=(3, 3), analyzer="char"
    )

    # Fit word vectorizer on training data only
    X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_final)

    # Transform test set and validate on held-out train data
    X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)
    X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_train_text)

    # Transform character features separately
    X_train_char = char_bigram_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_final)
    X_test_char = char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)
    X_val_char = char_bigram_vectorizer.transform(X_train_text)

    # Get training data after preprocessing
    X_train_original = []
    for i in range(len(X_train_text)):
        X_train_original.append(X_train_text[i])
    X_train_original = np.array(X_train_original)

    # Train full pipeline
    X_train_tfidf_combined = np.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char, X_val_char])

    # Combine and fit all three
    # Fit word vectorizer
    word_vectorizer.fit(X_train_text)

    # Re-process with consistent preprocessing and fitting
    X_train_processed = []
    for text in X_train_text:
        text = str(text).lower()
        text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        X_train_processed.append(text)

    X_train_processed = np.array(X_train_processed)
    X_test_processed = np.array([str(t).lower().replace(" ", "") for t in X_test_text])

    # Use single combined approach for better efficiency
    word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
    word_vec.fit(X_train_text)

    char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char", max_features=30000, ngram_range=(2, 2))
    char_vec.fit(X_train_text)

    X_train_features = np.column_stack(
        [word_vec.transform(X_train_text), char_vec.transform(X_train_text)]
    )
    X_val_features = np.column_stack(
        [
            word_vec.transform(X_train_text[val_indices]),
            char_vec.transform(X_train_text[val_indices]),
        ]
    )
    X_test_features = np.column_stack(
        [word_vec.transform(X_test_text), char_vec.transform(X_test_text)]
    )

    model = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=1.0)
    model.fit(X_train_features[train_indices], y_train_final)

    # Predict probabilities on test set
    test_probs_raw = model.predict_proba(X_test_features)
    row_sums = test_probs_raw.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1
    test_probs_norm = test_probs_raw / row_sums

    # Validate
    val_probs_raw = model.predict_proba(X_val_features)
    val_row_sums = val_probs_raw.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_row_sums[val_row_sums == 0] = 1
    val_probs_norm = val_probs_raw / val_row_sums
    validation_loss = calc_multiclass_log_loss(y_val, val_probs_norm)

    # Create submission file
    predictions = sample_sub.copy()
    for i in range(len(predictions)):
        predictions.iloc[i, 0] = test_df.iloc[i]["id"]
        predictions.iloc[i, 1] = round(float(test_probs_norm[i, 0]), 6)  # EAP
        predictions.iloc[i, 2] = round(float(test_probs_norm[i, 1]), 6)  # HPL
        predictions.iloc[i, 3] = round(float(test_probs_norm[i, 2]), 6)  # MWS

    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    predictions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission file generated successfully.")
    print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log-Loss: {validation_loss:.6f}")
    print("Solution complete.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
